thread:
Incident-Bot: :fire: Runtime alert: spike in kv-cache "cross-session" hits and stale-seq token emissions observed in region: ca-central-1. Error signature matches previous kv reuse regressions. Severity assigned: P1.

Ethan B.: Paging SRE oncall. @Priya V. can you take lead? Customers complaining about weird mixed outputs and unexpected tokens mid-stream.

Priya V.: I	m awake. Gathering traces and the most recent deploys. Which pools are noisy?

Sam K.: Noisy pools: shared-hosting-3 and two dedicated pools (dp-47, dp-81). Start ~1992467800. Noticed throughput drop and p95 spikes around same time.

QA-Juno: Quick repro on dev: run two streaming sessions with alternating short/long prompts. Observed that when continuous-batching merged requests, the KV cache returned entries computed from a different session when seq_offset was non-zero. Cache key logged as `cache_key=hash(prefix)` — missing `session_id` and `seq_offset`.

Priya V.: Sounds like the compact-key path removed entropy again. Immediate mitigations we can push without full deploy: 1) disable kv reuse, 2) increase continuous-batching idle threshold so mixing is less likely, 3) attach ephemeral per-request namespace. Which order?

Ethan B.: Do 1+2 first to minimize risk; namespace prefix as belt-and-suspenders while we restart pods. Legal-Team, please standby for possible outreach.

Priya V.: Applying config hotfix now. Patch being applied via configmap: 

```
# emergency hotfix 1992468101
runtime:
  kv:
    reuse_enabled: false
    include_session_id: true
    include_seq_offset: true
  batching:
    continuous:
      idle_ms: 60
      max_batch_tokens: 320
      max_inflight_requests: 6
```

Command used: 
```
kubectl -n runtime patch configmap runtime-config --patch-file=- <<'PATCH'
{ "data": { "hotfix.yaml": "runtime:\n  kv:\n    reuse_enabled: false\n    include_session_id: true\n    include_seq_offset: true\n  batching:\n    continuous:\n      idle_ms: 60\n      max_batch_tokens: 320\n      max_inflight_requests: 6\n" }}
PATCH
kubectl -n runtime rollout restart deploy/runtime -l region=ca-central-1
```

SRE-Bot: Rollout started for deploy/runtime (region=ca-central-1). 0/14 pods restarted.

Sam K.: Also enabling temporary debug hook to emit `cache_key_components` as structured logs (redacted). Will expire automatically after 45m.

QA-Juno: Kickoff regression runs against affected tenants as soon as first pod is ready. Adding fuzz of interleaved sequences.

Priya V.: Rolling restart underway. Noting that disabling reuse will likely increase token compute; watch cost/billing alerts.

SRE-Bot: Rollout progress: 5/14 pods restarted (35%).

Ethan B.: Customer impact summary so far: 7 tenants reported anomalous outputs; some fragments looked like short phrases from other chats. Flagging as potential sensitive context leakage until proven otherwise. CS & Legal notified.

Legal-Team: Reviewing. Recommend cautious customer language: say "possible intra-cluster context mixing" and offer to review transcripts and apply remediation credits if needed. Avoid definitive statements until postmortem.

Priya V.: After pod 6 came up, sampling logs show zero cross-session hits on that pod. Latency on that pod back to baseline at p50, p95 still slightly elevated (~12%).

Sam K.: After full rollout, debug logs show computed cache_key now contains session_id and seq_offset fields for 100% of samples. Good signal.

QA-Juno: Regression results (first pass): 0/1500 reproductions on hotfixed pods. Scheduling larger soak overnight.

Ethan B.: Drafting public statement for status page: "We detected an issue in our KV cache key derivation that under rare request interleavings could cause tokens from one stream to appear in another. We have applied emergency configuration changes to stop reuse and tightened batching windows in the affected region; rolled nodes show correctness restored. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a detailed postmortem."

Priya V.: Add note about perf impact in internal note: "Mitigation may increase compute cost and cause transient latency/throughput degradation while a safe reuse fix is developed."

Sam K.: Post-incident immediate action items: 1) revert the compact-key optimization that removed session/offset entropy, 2) add unit+fuzz tests that simulate interleaved streaming patterns and long-lived sessions, 3) create metric `kv_cache_cross_session_hits_total` and alert on any non-zero occurrence, 4) implement a pre-enable canary that runs interleaving fuzz before re-enabling reuse.

QA-Juno: Also add long-duration soak tests and a matrix that toggles batch idle_ms and max_batch_tokens to ensure no cache blowups occur at scale.

Priya V.: I'll own the code fix PR for correct key derivation (include session nonce + offset + model + prefix). Sam -> please own the canary plan and metrics. QA-Juno -> own the expanded test harness. Ethan -> coordinate with CS/Legal for customer follow-up and status updates.

SRE-Bot: Rollout complete (14/14 pods restarted). Debug logging will be retained for 45 minutes then auto-removed.

Ethan B.: Notifying affected account reps with conservative wording and offer for transcript review. Legal confirmed messaging.

Priya V.: Creating postmortem ticket and linking timeline. ETA for PR and canary: 36-48 hours. We'll aim to re-enable a safe reuse strategy only after passing the canary  no sooner.

Incident-Bot: Incident 1992468101 recorded as P1. Timeline entry saved.

Ethan B.: Handoff: Priya remains primary until fix merged and canary validated. Closing this coordination thread; reopen if new incidents occur. Great work team. :heart:
